summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing minutes of an October 30, 2026 Board of Directors meeting held by videoconference with all members present. The board elected Márcio de Andrade Schettini and Oscar Rodríguez Herrero to the Risk and Compliance Committee, confirmed that committee's full composition under coordinator Antonio Carlos Quintella, and elected Schettini to the Nomination and Governance Committee, with terms running to the first board meeting after the 2027 Annual Shareholders Meeting. This is routine board committee housekeeping, not a special situation; no transaction terms, advisors or recommendations are stated.
